P1.4.text: For over twenty years, Silvercrest has proudly served Individuals and Families, Institutional Investors, and Endowments & Foundations.

P1.6.text: Silvercrest: A Firm Committed to Excellence

P1.7.text: Our goal is to provide unparalleled advice to every client. Alongside our modern approach to portfolio construction, we offer the personalized service and open communication larger organizations can't, so clients feel confident and secure in choosing Silvercrest.

P1.8.text: Since our founding we have proudly served individuals and families with significant financial assets.

P1.9.text: Asset management is in our name. For over a decade, Silvercrest has partnered with select institutional clients to provide asset management, through our proprietary long-only equity management capabilities. We manage small through large cap value and growth equity, and international value strategies.

P1.10.text: Silvercrest partners with endowments, foundations and family offices to provide customized, full-service investment office solutions. The firm’s outsourced chief investment officer (OCIO) team leverages decades of experience managing nonprofits and family offices in tailoring portfolios to its clients’ distinctive financial goals, risk tolerances and mission objectives.

P1.11.text: In this issue of Insights, our team explores some of the most consequential forces shaping today’s markets and economy: the structure of the AI buildout, the philosophy of portfolio construction, and the geopolitical shifts reshaping how capital is deployed around the world.

P1.12.text: Same Question, Different Answer: Probabilistic AI in the Enterprise

P2.1.text: About Us | Silvercrest Asset Management Group

P2.2.text: Silvercrest is a firm of talented financial service advisors who provide fresh thinking to the management needs of our clients and firm.

P2.3.text: Silvercrest is a pioneer in the wealth management industry, setting the highest standards for independent investment advice and related family office services.

P2.4.text: We will always place our clients' needs first.

P2.5.text: We offer our individual and family clients robust investment capabilities trusted by sophisticated institutions.

P2.6.text: We tailor solutions to each client's goals.

P2.7.text: We provide a comprehensive family office solution, leveraging our deep expertise in tax, estate, philanthropic, and concierge services.

P2.8.text: We integrate world-class proprietary portfolio risk analytics and reporting.

P2.9.text: Clients choose Silvercrest for our integrity, consistency, and proven record of success.

P2.10.text: At Silvercrest, we’ve built a team of talented financial advisors who provide unwavering service to our clients according to their goals. We listen, we ask questions, and once we know exactly what you want, we apply our deep financial expertise to help you meet those goals.

P3.1.text: Endowments & Foundations | Silvercrest Asset Management Group

P3.2.text: We offer outsourced chief investment office solutions to foundations, endowments & institutions with long term investment time horizons.

P3.3.text: A Trusted Partner for Endowments & Foundations

P3.5.text: Silvercrest offers outsourced chief investment officer (“OCIO”) solutions to foundations, endowments and other institutions with long term investment time horizons.

P3.6.text: Understanding a client’s true risk tolerance is essential, as the primary risk is always a portfolio decline that leads to panicked selling and which can prevent the institution from achieving its long-term mission. Our team’s process focuses on understanding each client’s mission and long-term financial objective along with its portfolio preferences regarding risk, return, complexity, liquidity, mission-alignment and cost. The next step is to create a fully customized asset allocation and manager line-up that can achieve those goals and objectives in the most streamlined and cost-effective manner possible.

P3.7.text: The time tested strategy of portfolio diversification continues to be an important principle for any portfolio, whether a university endowment or a family foundation.

P3.8.text: How Fund Structure Shapes Outcomes: A Practical Guide

P1.3.text: Virtus Investment Partners is a distinctive partnership of boutique investment managers, singularly committed to the long-term success of individual and institutional investors.

P1.5.text: Individual Investor Financial Professional Institutional Investor or Consultant International Investor Non-U.S. Investor (UCITS & QIAIFs)

P2.2.text: A distinctive company with a multi-manager, multi-strategy model

P2.3.text: A Message from George R. Aylward President and Chief Executive Officer

P2.4.text: Welcome to Virtus Investment Partners, a company dedicated to being a distinctive and trusted provider of asset management solutions for individual and institutional investors.

P2.5.text: Our goal is to offer clients high-quality investment strategies that have generated compelling performance and meet multiple financial needs. To accomplish this, we employ a multi-manager, multi-strategy approach that delivers a broad array of solutions.

P2.6.text: Each of our investment partners has a distinct investment philosophy and style, with talent and discipline that have been tested through market cycles and validated by performance over time. Importantly, they all share an unwavering commitment to investor success.

P2.7.text: We hope you will consider joining us as a client.

P2.8.text: Our multi-manager, multi-strategy approach gives clients access to distinctive investment strategies from independent managers.

P2.9.text: We have the flexibility, agility, and responsiveness of a boutique asset management firm with the product breadth, distribution reach, and resources of larger firms.

P2.10.text: Our multi-boutique model is based on the fundamental belief that investment professionals who operate in an environment that allows for the appropriate focus and culture can generate sustainable, superior returns for our clients.

P3.1.text: AlphaSimplex Group, LLC | Virtus Investment Partners

P3.2.text: AlphaSimplex is a systematic alternatives manager focused on delivering quantitative investment strategies that are attuned to changing market dynamics.

P3.4.text: AlphaSimplex strives to help investors meet their long-term goals in ever-evolving markets by analyzing market behavior and risk. Our investment philosophy is based on the Adaptive Markets Hypothesis, an innovative theory of market behavior.

P3.6.text: Virtus AlphaSimplex Managed Futures Strategy Fund

P3.7.text: Virtus GF AlphaSimplex Managed Futures Fund

P3.10.text: Chief Investment Officer, Portfolio Manager Industry Start Date: 2007

P3.11.text: Alexander Healy is the chief investment officer and a portfolio manager at AlphaSimplex, an affiliated manager of Virtus Investment Partners. Dr. Healy is responsible for the day-to-day supervision of the research team and the implementation of the firm’s investment strategies. He is the chair of the firm’s investment committee and a member of the operating and risk committees. Additionally, he serves as a co-portfolio manager of certain funds.

P3.12.text: Dr. Healy joined AlphaSimplex and held the roles of senior research scientist, director of strategic research, and deputy chief investment officer. He has developed various key elements of AlphaSimplex’s investment platform, including non-parametric investment models, volatility management overlays, and dynamic approaches to portfolio construction.

P3.13.text: Dr. Healy earned an A.B. in mathematics and computer science from Harvard University, where he also received a Ph.D. in theoretical computer science. His doctoral research focused on the uses of randomness in algorithms and cryptography and introduced novel approaches to generating pseudo-random numbers together with new applications of these methods. P3.14.text: Chief Research Strategist, Portfolio Manager Industry Start Date: 2008

P3.15.text: Kathryn Kaminski is chief research strategist and a portfolio manager at AlphaSimplex, an affiliated manager of Virtus Investment Partners. Dr. Kaminski conducts applied research, leads strategic research initiatives, focuses on portfolio construction and risk management, and engages in product development. Dr. Kaminski is a member of the investment committee. Additionally, she serves as a co-portfolio manager for the AlphaSimplex Managed Futures Strategy and AlphaSimplex Global Alternatives Strategy.
